finding.problem: PASS_WITH_SCOPE alone accepted a review of another source/construction or a self-review; root pointer was not checked against the reviewed result pin.
finding.fix: Require current version/source pin, named distinct reviewer, exact result/construction byte equality and an actual result/construction pin inside the review; bind root pointer to result.delivery.

tests.name: no_result_pin
tests.reason: Review must pin RESULTADO.json or CONSTRUCTION_DELIVERY_V401.json

schema_contract.reviewer_or_actor: Distinct reviewer ID, string or {id:...}; this field is not authentication by itself.
schema_contract.evidence: At least one nested {path or file,sha256[,bytes]} pin to T/RESULTADO.json or C/CONSTRUCTION_DELIVERY_V401.json.

static_checks: Only submit/check/project/get/transition calls; no accept or publish operation.
Mission submission carries current revision/projection/lease and refuses concurrent revision changes.
Existing pending evidence is compared before continuing, without duplicate submission.
ACOM handles are read fresh and preserved in the CAS transition.
scope: Only the pure validation function extracted by AST was executed against synthetic local fixtures. submit_v401.main was not executed; no mission mutation, capture, TTS, finalizer or frozen-product write. Actual Goodall integration review is still pending.
